item.title: Роботакси Яндекса перевезли пассажиров более тысячи раз в двух районах Москвы / Yandex robotaxis complete more than a thousand passenger rides in two Moscow districts
item.description: Yandex published early trial data from Maryino and Lyublino; a test driver still sits behind the wheel. (source: https://autonomy.yandex.ru/blog/kak-zhiteli-marino-i-lyublino-znakomyatsya-s-nashim-robotaksi)

item.title: Gemini получила управление приложениями и сайтами на Mac / Gemini gains control of apps and websites on Mac
item.description: Google began a phased US rollout of computer use, limited by language, subscription, and device requirements. (source: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/computer-use-mac/)

item.title: В PyPI удалили две заражённые версии Microsoft Agent Framework / Two compromised Microsoft Agent Framework releases removed from PyPI
item.description: Versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 collected secrets on Python startup; researchers warn about cached copies and internal mirrors. (source: https://socket.dev/blog/agent-framework-pypi-package-compromised-with-credential-stealer)

item.title: Для nginx вышли исправления пяти уязвимостей из цепочки NGINX2Root / nginx releases fixes for five vulnerabilities in the NGINX2Root chain
item.description: Researchers describe remote code execution under specific configurations; the official fixed releases are 1.30.7 and 1.31.9. (source: https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html)

item.title: Anthropic назначила цену IPO в $83 за акцию; торги ожидаются сегодня / Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 a share, with trading expected today
item.description: The company announced an offering of 980 million shares; the planned Nasdaq debut does not mean the deal has closed. (source: https://www.anthropic.com/news/anthropic-prices-initial-public-offering)

item.title: Google начала выпуск Gemini 4 Neon для разработчиков и подписчиков / Google starts rolling out Gemini 4 Neon to developers and subscribers
item.description: The new model sits between fast Hydrogen and heavier Carbon; its reported benchmark results need independent scrutiny. (source: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/introducing-gemini-4-neon/)

item.title: Сбой Timeweb Cloud затронул облачные сервисы в нескольких регионах / Timeweb Cloud network outage affects services across several regions
item.description: The provider recorded partial unavailability from 13:28 to 14:52 Moscow time and reported recovery; the number of affected sites is unknown. (source: https://timeweb.cloud/live?tab=1)

item.title: Яндекс открыл бета-каталог плагинов для Алисы AI / Yandex opens a beta plugin catalogue for Alice AI
item.description: The catalogue has more than 20 integrations, and outside developers can submit an MCP server for review. (source: https://ir.yandex.ru/press-releases?id=16-11-2026-02&year=2026)

item.title: Команда Domyn адаптирует суперкомпьютер Jupiter для обучения модели почти на триллион параметров / Domyn adapts the Jupiter supercomputer for near-trillion-parameter model training
item.description: Researchers describe an experimental setup and higher throughput; training of the planned open model is still in progress. (source: https://www.domyn.com/blog/training-1t-moe-eu-public-infrastructure-pytorch)

item.title: Робот Caltech впервые самостоятельно собрал часть конструкции на орбите / Caltech robot autonomously assembles part of a structure in orbit
item.description: ASTRA added one bay to an antenna frame; the full reflector was not built, and the original announcement came on November 5. (source: https://www.caltech.edu/about/news/caltech-robotic-space-demo-successfully-builds-in-space)

item.title: Alibaba выпустила Qwen4-Max с контекстом в миллион токенов / Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max with a million-token context window
item.description: The flagship model is available through QwenCloud; performance and cost claims come from the company's own evaluations. (source: https://www.alibabacloud.com/en/press-room/alibaba-unveils-qwen4-max)

item.title: Apple запустила исследование того, как люди используют ИИ для вопросов о здоровье / Apple launches a study of how people use AI for health questions
item.description: A US research app studies trust and understanding, rather than offering a general medical service to all users. (source: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/11/apple-launches-research-study-to-explore-the-use-of-ai-for-health/)

item.title: Anthropic представила Claude Fable 5.2 и Mythos 5.2 / Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
item.description: Two versions of one model target demanding technical work, while access to Mythos requires organizational verification. (source: https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-2)

item.title: Зачем Boston Dynamics поставила Atlas на колеса / Why Boston Dynamics put wheels on Atlas
item.description: Wheeled Atlas is a research testbed for motor control and transferring simulated behavior to a physical robot. (source: https://bostondynamics.com/blog/atlas-on-a-roll/)

item.title: Роверы Яндекса начали доставлять заказы в Екатеринбурге / Yandex rovers begin deliveries in Yekaterinburg
item.description: The robots are serving six Lavka dark stores across three districts; broader coverage and more services remain plans. (source: https://autonomy.yandex.ru/blog/robodostavka-masshtabiruetsya-na-urale-rovery-yandeksa-nachali-privozit-zakazy-zhitelyam-ekaterinburga)

item.title: Роботрак Яндекса прошёл погрузку и разгрузку без водителя за рулём / Yandex tests driverless container handling at an active yard
item.description: The truck drove about 1.5 km through an operating yard and completed a container operation, with a remote operator and onboard observer still involved. (source: https://autonomy.yandex.ru/blog/kak-my-nauchili-robotrak-samostoyatelno-rabotat-na-kontejnernoj-ploshadke)

item.title: Physicl привлекла $10 млн на данные для обучения роботов / Physicl raises $10 million for targeted robot training data
item.description: Its Studio product recreates conditions in which a model fails, letting researchers train and evaluate changes in simulation. (source: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/11/06/3397485/0/en/physicl-raises-10-million-to-solve-physical-ai-s-edge-case-gap.html)

item.title: Amazon открыла Alexa for Shopping доступ к покупкам по SMS / Amazon brings Alexa for Shopping to text messages
item.description: A small invited group in the US can text the shopping agent, with broader access planned over the coming weeks. (source: https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/alexa-for-shopping-text-to-shop)

item.title: KDDI открыла предзаказ простого телефона INFOBAR ZERO в Японии / KDDI opens Japanese preorders for the simple INFOBAR ZERO phone
item.description: The phone focuses on calls, SMS, music, and a 2 MP camera, without a browser or social apps. Preorders opened November 18; sales are scheduled for December 25. It is an announced device, not one already shipping.

item.title: Microsoft представила семейство моделей Code 2 для программирования / Microsoft introduces its Code 2 coding-model family
item.description: At Ignite, Microsoft announced Code 2 and the faster Code 2 Flash for agentic development work. Microsoft says both are available in GitHub Copilot and Foundry; performance and efficiency claims currently come from the company.

item.title: RIKEN сообщил о несанкционированном доступе к сети суперкомпьютера Fugaku / RIKEN reports unauthorized access to Fugaku's operational network
item.description: RIKEN suspended Fugaku on November 14 after finding access through a public status dashboard. Its November 17 notice says user account data and credentials may be affected, while exfiltration of research files is unproven. A November 20 follow-up says the investigation continues.

item.title: Магнитные микророботы ускорили растворение тромбов в лабораторной модели / Magnetic microbots speed clot dissolution in a laboratory model
item.description: ETH Zurich reports a sixfold speedup in a silicone vessel model with pig-blood clots; in live pigs, the reopened vessel area after 30 minutes was twice as large. The method has not been used in people, and the paper is under review. The original report dates to November 9.

item.title: Google открыла Genie 4 в Project Genie для части подписчиков Ultra / Google opens Genie 4 in Project Genie to eligible Ultra subscribers
item.description: Eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers can now use the interactive world model, edit environments with text during a session, hear adaptive audio, and share creations. Pro users have a waitlist; Google acknowledges limits in physics and long-term scene persistence.

item.title: Сбер начал продажи портативной колонки СберБум Трек / Sber starts selling the portable SberBoom Track speaker
item.description: The GigaChat speaker costs 14,990 rubles. Sber claims up to eight hours of playback, local voice control for offline music, and Matter over Wi-Fi support. These are manufacturer specifications, not independent test results.

item.title: Google начала бесплатно открывать задачи Gemini в шести странах / Google begins free rollout of Gemini Tasks in six countries
item.description: Gemini Tasks powered by Hydrogen is rolling out without a subscription in the US, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, and India. Extra capabilities, including calls to businesses, begin in the US. This is a phased rollout, not worldwide availability.

item.title: Александр Чачава покинул совет директоров Яндекса / Alexander Chachava leaves Yandex's board
item.description: Yandex announced Chachava's departure from its board and said the change does not alter operations or strategy. It also said EU sanctions against him do not extend to Yandex group companies.

item.title: «Лаборатория Касперского» описала новую цепочку заражения Retadup и CoffeeLoader / Kaspersky details a new Retadup and CoffeeLoader infection chain
item.description: Researchers spotted the CoffeeLoader variant in August and published their technical analysis on November 16. The chain uses a modified 7z.dll and a new Armoury packer; it is malware research, not a claim that all USB drives are infected.

item.title: Plural привлекла €1 млрд для инвестиций в европейские технологические компании / Plural raises €1 billion for European technology investments
item.description: Plural partners told TechCrunch that two-thirds will go to its third early-stage fund and one-third to follow-on investments. Target areas include energy, AI infrastructure, defence, and health.

item.title: Яндекс и «36,6» запустили доставку аптечных заказов роверами в Москве / Yandex and 36.6 start rover delivery for pharmacy orders in Moscow
item.description: Yandex Autonomy announced that orders from 36.6 pharmacies can be delivered by rover through Yandex Delivery. The company post is dated November 13; availability depends on the order address.

item.title: Otter добавила 13 языков распознавания речи, включая русский / Otter adds 13 transcription languages, including Russian
item.description: The company announced 27 additional languages, but only 13 are available now. Another 14 and automatic language switching within a meeting are planned for later; the full 31-language lineup is not live yet.

item.title: Meta открыла доступ к компактной модели Muse Ember / Meta opens access to its compact Muse Ember model
item.description: The model for frequent bounded agent tasks is available in Muse Code and the Meta Model API. It accepts text, images, audio, and video; Meta lists input pricing from $0.10 per million tokens for prompts up to 200,000 input tokens.

item.title: Meta добавила создаваемые по описанию пространства в Muse / Meta adds prompt-built spaces to the Muse app
item.description: Users describe a tracker, planner or project board and Muse builds a space inside the app. Meta says it is available wherever Muse is already offered.

item.title: Serve Robotics предложила другим компаниям сервисы для роботов / Serve Robotics opens its physical AI tools to other robot builders
item.description: Physical AI Services packages robot connectivity, data curation and data from Serve's own fleet. Serve names Bedrock Robotics among its launch customers.

item.title: Meta запустила голосовые разговоры с аватаром Muse в США / Meta rolls out voice conversations with the Muse avatar in the US
item.description: Muse Realtime Voice and Avatar bring live conversations to mobile, web and Mac. Support for AI glasses and the planned Charm device is still upcoming.

item.title: OpenAI представила GPT-6 Cyber для авторизованных исследований безопасности / OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Cyber for authorized security research
item.description: The model targets vulnerability discovery and validation. Initial API and Codex access is limited to selected approved Daybreak Red users.

item.title: Dropbox договорилась купить Tigris Data за $350 млн / Dropbox agrees to buy Tigris Data for about $350 million
item.description: The AI-oriented object storage acquisition has not closed. Dropbox expects completion in the fourth quarter and also announced DBX Agent Cloud.

item.title: Aina открыла предзаказ кольца с экраном и управлением ИИ / Aina opens preorders for a screen-equipped AI control ring
item.description: The ring combines an OLED display, microphone, speaker and physical controller. The company expects first shipments in early 2027; it is a preorder, not a mass-market release.
